items.title: Corendon Website Adds Klarna Options in Seven European Markets
items.why: Travel checkout BNPL is spreading to European leisure operators; a US travel-lending pitch could follow.
items.summary_ai: Travel operator Corendon now offers Klarna payment options on its website across seven European markets.
items.take: Travel checkout BNPL is spreading to European leisure operators; a US travel-lending pitch could follow.
